The '''IR-8K Covert Assassin Droid''' was a model of [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] used by [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]], a freelance [[Spy/Legends|spy]] active during the [[Galactic War]]. Equipped with a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] and [[Stealth field generator/Legends|stealth field generator]], IR-8K Covert Assassin Droids were among the forces guarding [[B-NK1]]'s base in the back room of the [[Dealer's Den]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="SG" />
